actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. _Failure:_ 18 (4d8) Acid damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Slowing Breath
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
